subject: Island power patch / AV grid planning for CloudConf booth
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@expoops.com>, greg.oneill@venuewifi.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial AV/power ask for island booth (corner 12F)

Hi Samantha / Greg —

Thanks again for confirming booth 12F for Redwood (island, 20x20). We're starting to lock down the AV and power layout so the build vendor can quote. High-level asks: 

- 1x 20A 120V single-phase dedicated circuit for demo station A (left side)
- 1x 20A 120V for TV wall (backwall LED panel) requiring internal distribution box
- 2x network drops for demo machines (wired preferred)
- Overhead lighting tie-in point and mounting anchor location for hanging sign

Attached is our current floorplan (floorplan_v3.pdf) and a draft cable list. Can you confirm whether the venue provides cable snake service from floor box to the overhead? Also advise on available load for hanging signage — we may need an additional rigging point.

Goal is to get a vendor-ready power map by EOD Monday (2026-09-14).

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@expoops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Greg O'Neill <greg.oneill@venuewifi.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial AV/power ask for island booth (corner 12F)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — happy to help. Quick answers: 

- The floor box at 12F has two available 20A circuits; we can provision a third but it'll require a run from the nearest distro (additional labor fee).
- We do offer a venue-provided cable snake service; runs are billed per-linear-foot. Greg (venue AV) is copied and can provide exact rates.
- Rigging: the hall rigging grid has an available anchor in the immediate bay; hanging a 6ft sign is okay up to 40 lbs without special permit. Anything heavier needs an engineered rig.

I'll loop in our freight partner if you want them to handle a booth-level distro.

Samantha
Samantha Ruiz
Expo Operations Manager — ExpoOps
Samantha.Ruiz@expoops.com

Attachments: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: vendor quote inputs + who owns distro ordering?

Team —

Samantha confirmed we can get the runs but extra circuit labor will be billed. Need to decide: do we route the extra distro through LogiShip (vendor we used at Moscone) or let venue handle distro and cable? Pros: LogiShip handles on-site patching and returns the distro at end; cons: higher cost.

Requesting: 
- Marissa: can you pull last year's LogiShip quote and confirm labor/day rates?
- Marcus: help confirm monitor sizes for TV wall (I think it's 2x 55" in portrait).
- Hannah: confirm whether we want wired demo machines (2) or WiFi-only for one to save a drop.

If we decide venue handles cable runs, I'll ask Samantha for final line-item pricing. Otherwise I'll open an SOW with LogiShip. Need decision by Monday EOD to keep the install window.

-Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: vendor quote inputs + who owns distro ordering?

Jonas —

Pulled LogiShip files from last event. Key numbers (summary): 
- Booth distro + setup/tear: $1,200 flat (includes one 20A run & patching)
- Each additional circuit run: $250
- On-site tech (per day): $450
- Cable snake pass-through (venue): typically $0.45/ft (they billed 75ft last time)

I'll upload the detailed PDF to the drive link. My read: LogiShip is slightly more expensive but reduces risk during install. If we want to keep headcount small, go LogiShip.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: vendor_contacts.csv (CSV)

From: Greg O'Neill <greg.oneill@venuewifi.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@expoops.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:52:00-07:00
Subject: Venue AV note + cable feed locations

Jonas / team —

Quick technical note from venue AV: the floor boxes on the island are centered along the back third of the footprint. If you want a clean backwall TV hatch, you'll need a short whip (~6ft) or a shallow floor channel. For the hanging sign, we'll need placement coordinates — please provide a dimensioned plan with origin point B1 (attached).

Also, we recommend the following for stability: 
- TV wall: use our HDMI over fiber feed for runs >25ft (we can provide active extenders).
- Demo station A: place within 8ft of floor box to avoid long power runs.

Greg
Greg O'Neill
Venue AV Lead — Moscone West
greg.oneill@venuewifi.com

Attachments: cable_schedule.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@expoops.com>, Greg O'Neill <greg.oneill@venuewifi.com>, ops@logiship.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final decision: LogiShip to provide booth distro + install SOW

Team / Vendors —

Decision: we'll engage LogiShip to provide booth distribution, on-site patching, and hanging sign rigging coordination. Reasons:

- Lower install risk during tight load-in window
- One vendor to manage cable snakes and distro simplifies cutover

Jonas action items:
- Marissa to confirm SOW + PO numbers (Marissa, please confirm by EOD tomorrow)
- Marcus to confirm TV dimensions (send final specs)
- Hannah to finalize whether demo machine 2 needs wired drop (if yes, include in SOW)
- Samantha / Greg: final line-item confirmation from venue (we'll accept their run fees and rigging note)

LogiShip / ops@logiship.com please reply with acceptance of the scope below and an ETA for draft SOW. Attached are the plan files for reference.

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth load-in week.

Jonas
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132
